explain.heading: Session One — Age of Accomplishment & the ascent
explain.text: Establishes the Age of Accomplishment pressure system, inverted Kafai ranking, metatitle/relative-title pursuit and Zubaida’s first Grand Reincarnation attempt. The first application is placed on hold because Qai’lyth judges the mutual-love threshold not yet satisfied.

explain.heading: Session Two — Pinnacle records
explain.text: Records source-era top-ten snapshots for intelligence, Divine Power, Kafai rank and clan rank. These lists are chronology-sensitive current records in this transmission and must not silently overwrite earlier or later rankings.

explain.heading: Session Three — Continued struggle & reincarnation quest
explain.text: Continues through an Orotion Quest in Talmorai, an alliance/Sehexi phase and the Tactical Vanguard relative-title. The later verdict in the same transmission explicitly changes Zubaida’s reincarnation state from on-hold to approved and completed, with consciousness and memories retained and Kafai status reset.

chronology: Session One places the Grand Reincarnation request on hold; Session Three later records Qai’lyth’s approval and the reincarnation as completed. Render both states in order.
Session Two explicitly presents its intelligence, Divine Power, Kafai and clan lists as current pinnacle records; preserve them as a source-era snapshot.

algorithm: Load data/zubaida-index.json and remove every ID in data/zubaida-nonsource.json; resulting array is the authoritative 118-source order.
Load each adapter file. Resolve every batch record by transmission ID first, never by its reported ordinal alone.
Attach all contributions with the same transmission ID to that source record; source 60 deliberately has two contributions.
For source 80 use repair.position_80 because no original batch record targets that source ID.
Return records in authoritative source order. Never duplicate or replace source text.
